sentence: This project tries to find out the role of the blood microbiome in asthma.
This project shows how mathematics, physics, and engineering are combined with biology in cancer research.
This project studies how chemical tags on RNA molecules change as muscles age and lead to muscle loss.
This project tries to find ways to detect cardiac allograft vasculopathy early and to prevent it in heart transplant patients.
This project tries to find basic principles behind diseases related to otolaryngology and to use those discoveries to improve health.
This project provides immunological assays and data analysis that look for biomarkers of immune competence, diagnosis, and response to therapy or vaccination.
This project tests how increased intracellular pH in cancer cells can be targeted to limit cancer metabolism and tumorigenesis.
This project provides statistical and bioinformatics support for studies on how pollutants and social domain factors affect human health and disease risk.
This project develops inhibitors of Human Cytomegalovirus that target the helicase primase complex.
This project builds diagnostics that detect infections caused by microbes, including resistant infections, in blood or other biofluids.
This project develops mass spectrometry methods to study how metabolites and proteins regulate each other in metabolism.
This project studies the pathways that cause axon dysfunction in Charcot Marie Tooth disease to find new targets for treatment.
This project builds a multiomic biodosimetry panel that measures radiation exposure more accurately in people who also have an infection.
This project tests whether personalized tools affect engagement and outcomes in exercises for anxiety.
This project studies how cooling agents in e-cigarette aerosols affect cardiac electrophysiology, hemodynamics, and respiration in adolescent and adult mouse models.
This project builds a system that reduces stuttering by altering auditory feedback using a person's real-time brain signals.
This project builds a deep learning model that uses clinical variables and breast biopsy microscopy image features to predict breast cancer recurrence and mortality.
This project studies how de novo pyrimidine biosynthesis contributes to pathological cardiac remodeling and heart failure.
This project tries to find out how food-food and food-gene interactions change the effect of saturated fat on low-density lipoprotein cholesterol.
This project studies how the transition from elongation to termination is controlled in transcription by RNA polymerase II.
